text:
sara: Quick async sync on the kernel -> continuous-batching sprint. I opened a kernel PR that changes the KV warmup handshake and sequence window handling. Need clear owners for canary + observability so we don't lose time. Blocker: eng-infra needs to update the docker base image to include the new kernel module mount flags. TL;DR: canary this week if infra patch lands. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1342

vikram: Reviewing now, left a couple of nits and one TODO around memmap alignment. Microbench shows ~+4% tail p99 in one case, digging in. Will iterate today and push a follow-up. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1342

kevin: FYI I hit a flaky in integration: `kv_warmup_integration` is failing intermittently on x86-nv. Log snippet: ```ERROR: failed to attach shm: missing segment``` — looks like mount flags or privs. Spending time reproing locally.

olivia: @kevin I can own the canary run if infra confirms the mount fix. I can coordinate with eng-infra and run the staging canary after 3pm PT today.

maria: Heads-up on observability: we need `kv.prefetch.hit_rate` and `kv.handshake.latency_ms` exported from runtime so we can correlate warmup behavior with p99. I'll open an instrumentation PR (planning EOD) and add a Prom rule.

vikram: Thanks @maria — please add label `prefetch_window` on the metric. Note the handshake now also emits `handshake_latency_ms` and `handshake_attempts`.

kevin: Infra ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-4321 — eng-infra assigned to @sam, ETA ~48h. This covers docker flag + shm mount perms.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-2026-03-18-71 (initiated by @olivia)

sara: Great — plan: if infra fix lands in ~48h we aim for canary Thu. Acceptance criteria: p99 tail <= 120ms (no uplift) and error rate stable. Owners: kernel = @vikram, canary+deploy = @olivia, infra liaison = @sam, observability = @maria. Anyone want to swap?

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary, collect perf snapshots, and post results here.

vikram: I'll push a micro-optim tomorrow morning to try to recover the +4% tail.

kevin: If I can't get the shm repro fixed before the canary, @olivia please abort and we revert. I'll keep this ticket prioritized.

maria: Instrument PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/210 — adds `kv.prefetch.hit_rate` and alerting if hit_rate drops >3% post-deploy. I'll add runbook steps for interpreting the metric.

sara: Thanks all. Quick ask: after the canary, drop p50/p95/p99 + error-rate and any anomalies. If you can't post here, add a short note to the release notes thread. I'll mark INFRA-4321 blocked until sam confirms the fix.

sam: Picking this up now, ETA ~36-48h depending on test. I'll update the ticket and ping infra-ops for expedited validation.

olivia: Copy — I'll queue the canary checklist and notify support for a quick watch window.

vikram: Also, small reminder: update the rollout policy to allow fallback to the previous kernel variant if the canary sees >1% error spike. I can add the policy change PR after we validate.

kevin: Noted. I'll report back here with any reproductions.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: canary-2026-03-18-71 (status: started) - awaiting metric snapshots

sara: Perfect. Keep thread updated. If anything slips or someone needs me to reassign owners, ping me directly.
